jobs.title: Associate Accounting (m/w/d)
jobs.reason: An accounting role is well outside the candidate's research/policy profile and skill set — bookkeeping and finance are not areas of demonstrated competence. Nothing hard disqualifies it, but the paper fit and interest alignment are both minimal, so it barely warrants surfacing.

jobs.title: Intern (m/f/d) Carbon Markets & Pricing / International Carbon Action Partnership (ICAP) Secretariat
jobs.reason: This is explicitly an internship for current students, which is excluded as a matter of policy. The topic (carbon markets / climate policy) also sits outside the candidate's core interest zones, but the internship status is the decisive disqualifier.

jobs.title: Wissenschaftliche Museumsassistenz in Fortbildung (w/d/m) im Bereich Kommunikation
jobs.reason: This is an entry-level museum-communications traineeship requiring a completed Master's, which the candidate will have, so it is not disqualified — but it demands demonstrated social-media and press experience, an area the candidate lacks, and the work is comms-focused rather than research. The modern-art / museum-communications field sits outside the candidate's core interest zones, holding the score low despite technical eligibility.

jobs.title: Venture Manager Compute (m/f/x)
jobs.reason: The role requires an established track record at the intersection of entrepreneurship and high-performance/quantum computing or AI, plus experience managing teams and running startup accelerators — a "Professional" career-level position well beyond the candidate's entry-level profile and outside their skills. The deep-tech venture-management focus also sits well outside the candidate's international-law and policy interest zones.

jobs.title: CRM Spezialist (m/w/d) Datenanalyse & Datenqualität
jobs.reason: This is a BI / CRM data-specialist role requiring a degree in business informatics / data science and hands-on experience with Dynamics 365, Power BI, Power Apps, Azure and SQL — a specific technical toolset the candidate's analysis-level SPSS/Python/Excel does not cover, so the paper fit is weak even though not strictly disqualifying. It sits entirely outside the candidate's international-law / geopolitical-risk / research interest zones, in nature-conservation fundraising operations, so interest is minimal.

jobs.title: Studentischer Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) Spendenservice
jobs.reason: This is a Werkstudent (working-student) position, which is excluded as a matter of policy. It also requires enrolment in an economics/business programme and is a donation-service/admin role with no fit to the candidate's profile or interests.

jobs.title: Bibliothekar:in (w/d/m)
jobs.reason: The role requires a completed degree in library and information science (or equivalent library-specific skills) plus hands-on experience with GND, RDA and continuous resources — an essential specialist profile the candidate does not hold. It is also a specialist librarian cataloguing post outside all three interest zones, and effectively requires working with almost exclusively foreign-language (Spanish) materials.

jobs.title: Praktikant (m/w/d) im Themenmanagement der Abteilung Klima, Umwelt, Infrastruktur
jobs.reason: This is explicitly a Praktikum / internship, which is excluded by policy, and it further requires current enrolment or graduation within the last 6 months. The climate/environment development-cooperation focus also sits outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Research Associate for the Project "Cluster of Excellence Understanding Written Artefacts"
jobs.reason: This is a postdoctoral position requiring an already-obtained (or submitted) PhD, which the candidate does not hold — a hard disqualifier. It also requires fluency in Spanish and expertise in precolonial Mesoamerican studies, neither of which the candidate has.
